rows.measure: Tax and the owner's compulsory contributions on a profit of 40,000 EUR, sole trader, 2026 rules
rows.note: Regime: ordinary regime: IRPEF with the Lazio and Rome surcharges, and INPS as a shopkeeper (commerciante). Alternatives: the flat-rate regime (regime forfetario, revenue to EUR 85,000) taxes revenue times the activity's coefficient at 15% (5% for the first five years), replaces IRPEF and the surcharges, and cuts INPS on it by 35%. Its result depends on revenue, not profit (not computed).
